{{Top}}
{{Quote|If I activate this control, the outside airlock will open, and she will be sucked into oblivion. Do you think you can kill me and then save her before she's pulled out into space? It's a horrible way to die.|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] regarding [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>}}
[[File:Slave_I_airlock.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] standing in the airlock of [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]]]
An '''airlock''' was a structure built into most [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] that allowed beings to enter or exit pressurized [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] from the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], or sometimes, into high-pressure [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] depths. A user would enter the pressurized airlock wearing a [[Environment suit/Legends|space suit]], and both exits would be sealed. At this point, the airlock could be safely depressurized so the user could exit the craft. Airlocks were sometimes used for [[Death/Legends|executions]] as well.

Some ships had airlocks as interior components, such as the prisoner cells aboard [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss's]] ship, the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']]. Because Zuckuss would commonly keep his ship pumped full of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]], the prisoner cells had airlocks so that they could be filled with [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], which would prevent the captured [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from suffocating, all the while leaving Zuckuss unaffected.<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
